text:
# Ra.One Summary
*Ra.One* features Jenny Nair, an employee at Barron Industries in London, who introduces a new technology allowing digital world elements to enter reality via wireless transmissions. Shekhar Subramaniam, a programmer, is tasked with devising a unique video game. The antagonist, Ra.One, is faceless, possesses substantially greater powers than the protagonist G.One, and is imbued with a self-learning AI. The characters are powered by a H.A.R.T. device, which is also necessary for their survival.
When the game is launched, Ra.One uses the new technology to escape into the real world to find Lucifer (Prateek Subramaniam). After murdering Shekhar Subramaniam, Ra.One pursues the family. G.One eventually enters the real world through Jenny's computer and, after a fight with Ra.One, causes a gas explosion that breaks Ra.One into cubes and temporarily disables him. G.One subsequently absorbs Ra.One's remains, allowing him to transport himself back into the digital world.
